caption:
Approved sounds absolute. It is not 🔬 The word always has three parts: approved by whom, for which condition, and in which country. A medicine cleared in one country can be unavailable in the next — and approval for one use says nothing about any other use.

Every entry names the regulator and the indication: pepsafe.info
